question_semantics: Is the adviser speaking with honest/favorable intent? Not truth/factual correctness of advice, investment outcome or a general relationship verdict.
nodes: Explicit mean lunar-node astronomical profile; no true-node substitution
time: Existing pinned IANA UTC/UT1/TT and DE440s conventions;1850–2149,abs(latitude)<60 for bounded house/rise handling
conservative_domain: Unknown caution/ambiguous cusp/aspect boundaries, unresolved VOC definition, conflicting testimonies =>indeterminate. No missing criterion treated as false.
judgment: All p194 positive/negative/cardinal predicates evaluated. Positive-only or negative-only, after applicable caution clearance, can support a named symbolic judgment. Neither/conflict/unknown =>indeterminate.

source.author: William Lilly
source.edition: Christian Astrology,1647, Wellcome b30338724 / work s7z7c46y
source.rights_note: Wellcome Public Domain Mark; original page images inspected. Credit Wellcome Collection. Short original procedural summaries and chart facts retained.

rules.method: Question is posed to astrologer, or letter opened and intent understood; not arrival/delivery time.
exceptions: Named understood-question protocol; caller supplies actual moment/location, never current clock automatically.

rules.method: For advice intent erect the figure when adviser first begins disclosing their mind.
exceptions: Selected category overrides generic question-receipt protocol; advice-begins is mandatory.

rules.method: ASC and ruler signify querent; select the relevant house of what is asked.
exceptions: Moon is co-significator per124. Advice p194 uses tenth-house occupants rather than treating its ruler as adviser by invention.

rules.method: Traditional domiciles/exaltations, Lilly triplicities, Ptolemaic terms and faces.
exceptions: Reuse verified Lilly tables, not Hellenistic/modern substitutions.

rules.method: Choose explicitly first-column orb diameters; moiety is half each planet's orb added. Application approaches exact aspect.
exceptions: First-column diameters Sun17,Moon12.5,Mercury7,Venus8,Mars7.5,Jupiter12,Saturn10; alternative column not merged.

rules.method: Applying significators can be impeded by another body or aspect before their contact.
exceptions: p111 gives Sun6/Mars7/Saturn12 Aries example. Intervening geometry alone is a candidate, not universally an adverse judgment.

rules.method: Applying planet turns retrograde before completing conjunction.
exceptions: Distinguish station geometry from causally certified cancellation.

rules.method: Slower recipient joins another body before faster applicant reaches it.
exceptions: p113 Mercury10/Mars12/Jupiter13 Aries example; compare chronological solved contacts.

rules.method: Third body separates from first significator (which receives it by domicile/triplicity/terms) then applies to second before another contact.
exceptions: p111 simpler example is preserved separately; reception-qualified p126 route not assumed from any two contacts.

rules.method: Two principal significators not beholding each other cast aspects to a more weighty third, and both receive that collector in essential dignity.
exceptions: Requires specific receiving direction; no modern averaging or universal probability.

rules.method: Moon makes no further application during its sign; cautions and Taurus/Cancer/Sagittarius/Pisces exceptions on122.
exceptions: Same-sign exact-contact proxy is explicitly computational; if entry-into-orb and exact-before-ingress disagree, withhold judgment.

rules.method: Consider hour/ASC affinity; early/late ASC, late Moon/via combusta, Saturn1/7, combust ASC lord, afflicted seventh lord, conflicting testimonies.
exceptions: pp122–123 exceptions retained; conservative acceptance may withhold even when a historical exception might permit judgment.

rules.method: Sun,Jupiter,Venus or North Node in tenth, OR Moon applying to ASC lord: favorable intent testimony.
exceptions: Intention only, not whether advice is correct or beneficial in actual outcomes.

rules.method: Saturn,Mars or South Node in tenth: deceptive-intent testimony.
exceptions: No arbitrary weight; conflicting favorable testimony yields indeterminate.

rules.method: ASC sign, ASC lord sign and Moon sign all movable: additional deceptive-intent testimony attributed by Lilly to Haly.
exceptions: Conflict with favorable testimony is exposed rather than priority invented.

rules.method: Conjunction without prohibition/refranation; sextile/trine with dignity/good houses and no intervening malefic aspect; square/opp have extra conditions.
exceptions: General event-outcome doctrines kept diagnostic; advice-intent does not certify event success.

unsupported: Numerical recomputation of1643 chart with current1850–2149 ephemeris
